tagline: Leading integrated fashion retailer delivering omnichannel retail and finance solutions across UK and international markets
hero_kpi_rationale: Group total sales growth of 10.8% reflects solid NEXT performance in a dynamic market environment, demonstrating the company's ability to generate significant organic growth across integrated Retail and Online channels.

kpis.name: Group Revenue (£bn)
kpis.explanation: Consolidated revenue across the entire group including Retail, Online and subsidiaries.
kpis.description: Total group sales for the year ended January 2026, up 10.8% versus prior year (£6,321m in January 2025).
kpis.signal: Sales growth and overall business health.

kpis.name: Profit Before Tax (£m)
kpis.explanation: Group net profit before taxes, reflecting operational profitability.
kpis.description: NEXT group profit before tax of £1,158m for the year ended January 2026, up 14.5% versus £1,011m in January 2025.

kpis.name: Post-Tax Earnings Per Share (pence)
kpis.explanation: Net income per ordinary share after taxes.
kpis.description: NEXT group post-tax EPS of 744.2p for the year ended January 2026, up 17.0% versus 636.3p in January 2025.
kpis.signal: Shareholder value creation and per-share profitability.

kpis.name: Shareholder Returns (£m)
kpis.explanation: Total amount of dividends, share buybacks and capital distributions returned to shareholders.
kpis.description: Total shareholder returns of £839m for the year, comprising dividends (£286.5m), share buybacks (£131.4m) and B Share Scheme distribution (£421.5m).
kpis.signal: Active shareholder return policy and capital management.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last four years. Metric tracked annually, with historical values over four years.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 4.92bn € in latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 1.81bn € in latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of 0.1bn € in latest year

kpis.name: Sales Growth Guidance 2026/27
kpis.explanation: Projected full-price sales growth for the year ended January 2027.
kpis.description: NEXT maintains full-price sales growth guidance of 4.5% for the upcoming year (year ended January 2027).

kpis.name: Profit Before Tax Guidance 2026/27 (£m)
kpis.explanation: Forecast profit before tax for the year ended January 2027.
kpis.description: Upwardly revised guidance of £1,210m for profit before tax in FY2026/27, representing 4.5% growth versus FY2025/26 performance (£1,158m).
kpis.signal: Profitability outlook and earnings growth trajectory.

kpis.name: Middle East Crisis Impact (£m)
kpis.explanation: Anticipated additional costs related to Middle East instability.
kpis.description: NEXT has factored in £15m of anticipated additional costs (fuel, air freight) related to Middle East disruptions, representing approximately 6% of total revenue. These costs have been offset by savings elsewhere and do not alter current guidance on a three-month disruption assumption.
kpis.signal: Geographic exposure and operational risks from geopolitical disruptions.

kpis.name: Planned Shareholder Returns 2026/27 (£m)
kpis.explanation: Anticipated shareholder returns through buybacks, dividends or capital distributions for FY2026/27.
kpis.description: NEXT anticipates £500m in shareholder returns for FY2026/27 through share buybacks, special dividends or capital distributions.
kpis.signal: Continued active shareholder return policy and capital management.

risks.title: International Supplier Dependence
risks.score_rationale: Risk flagged as principal in 10-K with strong language on persistent supply chain pressure. Trend is upward (↑) due to global conflicts and extended transit delays. Category is central to manufacturing and distribution operations.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and External Attacks
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified as principal with regular updates to Audit Committee. Intensity of language is high with mention of targeted attacks and response testing. Trend is stable but critical, and group technology dependence is strong.

risks.title: Product Selection and Design
risks.score_rationale: Risk is recurring and directly tied to brand viability. Language emphasizes impact on reputation and margins in case of failure. Trend is stable but critical as it relates to customer loyalty and product differentiation.

risks.title: Supplier Compliance (Social Practices)
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly linked to NEXT Code of Practice and regular audits. Audit Committee receives updates on modern slavery and corruption. Trend is stable but reputational exposure is high.

risks.title: Limited Geographic Diversification
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned in supply chain and geopolitical tensions context. Language is moderate but group acknowledges increased exposure through international growth. Trend is upward.

risks.title: Technology Systems Resilience
risks.score_rationale: Technology is described as key infrastructure component. Risk relates to business continuity and cyberthreats. Trend is stable but integrated across multiple principal risks.

risks.title: Climate Preference Evolution
risks.score_rationale: Climate risk assessed as non-material short-term but monitored via ESG group. Trend implicitly upward. Weight is moderate but growing due to regulatory and consumer expectations.

ai_positioning.summary: NEXT integrates AI and advanced technologies into its omnichannel operations to optimize inventory management, product recommendations and operational efficiency. The company's approach focuses on improving customer experiences through data and innovative analytics.
evidence: Investments in digital supply chain solutions and inventory optimization through advanced technologies
Use of customer data and analytics to refine product positioning and pricing strategies
Growing integration of online and retail capabilities through a unified technology platform
Continued development of NEXT Finance services with data utilization for credit assessment and risk management
